limitations: No connected clients; not representative of 50+ players or SendMaps.
Fixed seed does not make background simulation identical. Three repeats do not establish statistical significance.
Whole-process CPU per completed atmosphere tick includes all other server systems; not kernel latency.
Profiler inclusive times overlap; do not add parent and child totals.
Memory sampled about once per second; private and working set must not be added.
Runtime-rejected captures and the ten-minute diagnostic soak do not enter the 60-second performance summary.
Native benchmark has explicit topology and disabled conduction; not the full MetaStation simulation.
Hotspot color cadence, production deployment, Linux, target BYOND version and full-round endurance remain unverified.
